decisions.target_truth: Keep the ordinary noun and adjective branches, but replace the scientifically brittle Core definition based on voluntary movement with a broad learner-safe animal concept; do not define Animalia by one non-universal trait.
Single ordinary anatomical noun is correct and learner-relevant; current sprain/joint collocations are coherent.
Yearly recurrence/commemoration of a date is correctly centered and sufficiently represented.

Center one ordinary announce/make known publicly or officially branch and expose high-value complements such as announce sth / announce that-clause; avoid over-splitting a vague notice/presage branch as an equal main sense.
Ordinary transitive make irritated/annoyed meaning and passive pattern are coherent.

Keep yearly/once-a-year and per-year/calculated-over-a-year adjective uses as learner core. Downgrade annual=n yearly publication and botanical annual=n annual plant to recognition/reference rather than equal main Active branches.
Keep anonymous/unknown identity-or-source as core plus the extended indistinct/unremarkable sense as a valid secondary branch.
Keep another = one more / a different one. Do not treat one another as an ordinary collocation of this sense; own it as a reciprocal phrase/construction boundary.

Keep noun answer, transitive answer a question/person/phone, answer for = be responsible, and answer a need/description/purpose = satisfy/fit where useful. Correct answer for governing pattern to with-for, and consolidate overlapping answer↔respond vs answer↔reply/respond Relation ownership into one non-duplicative contrast.
Single ordinary insect noun is correct and learner-relevant.
Keep device aerial and insect sensory appendage branches; both are ordinary modern meanings.

Center foresee/expect in advance with anticipate sth / doing / that-clause. Keep act-before/pre-empt as a distinct lower branch. Avoid duplicate construction presentation for anticipate that; do not over-separate emotional look-forward-to as an equal main branch.
Restore ordinary noun antique = old valuable object and adjective antique = old/period-valued. Keep rare verbs such as shop for antiques / give an antique appearance out of the main learner map.
Keep anxiety as state/feeling of worry and plural/instance causes of worry as a useful secondary noun branch.
Keep worried/anxious about and eager/anxious to/for as two high-value modern branches.
Determiner/pronoun any plus adverbial any degree are all high-value grammar distinctions and currently coherent.
Center pronoun anybody = any person. Downgrade rare noun anybody = a person of standing/importance to recognition/reference rather than main Active learner content.

Preserve anyhow ≈ anyway/in any case and genuine manner use in any way/carelessly as appropriate, but rewrite the first branch so its discourse meaning is explicit and not the opaque 'explains or supports previous statement' gloss; separate discourse vs manner use cleanly.
Keep pronoun anything = any thing/matter and add high-value construction anything but = definitely not / far from; do not leave the familiar word as a one-line pronoun only.

Center one-word anyway as in any case/despite that/discourse-resumption or at-least marker. Remove or reclassify current 'in any way whatsoever' branch as primarily two-word any way, preserving the spelling/grammar boundary explicitly.

relation_truth.target_truth: The answer↔respond contrast is valid (answer takes direct object; respond normally takes to), but it overlaps a broader answer↔reply/respond owner. Consolidate to one authoritative relation rather than duplicate the respond boundary.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
Contemporary usage checks were used only where a decision depended on modern licensing/spelling boundary (notably anyway vs any way).
